extraction.Name: Morris Joseph Douville
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: No, I mortgaged and then sold it.
extraction.Fee Patent Date: about nine or ten years ago (from March 26, 1929)
extraction.NOTES: Did not remember signing receipt for patent; was pretty sick at the time having just returned from Omaha where he had an operation performed removing his appendix. Got $2400 in money and a team valued at $200 for the land. Satisfied with the sale. No debts settled between him and the purchaser. Has six children. Patent delivered by brother-in-law. Subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Gross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32.
